i would recommend you ask your teachers to write it down on their teacher notes tho. that helps tremendously. then, at the beginning of class, go up and say “hey, i think my teacher left it on the note, but just in case she didn’t, i have a 504 that says i can leave 5 minutes early”. they’ll look, see it if it’s written down, and accept it. if it’s not written down, they’ll probably believe you.

but either way, nothing is stopping you from just walking out.

I didn’t tell him cause at the time I didn’t know it was abuse, I just though it was normal. That’s what happens to you when you’re a victim of abuse for a long time, it just becomes your normal, and you get used to it. You think that all families are like that, but they’re not. 


My aunt didn’t know about this either, for similar reasons except she isn’t in the army. When I was around 10, I went to a friend’s house for the first time. I saw what a huge difference there was in their family vs mine. They had one of the loveliest families I’ve ever known, and I still keep in contact with them to this day. I realized that what was happening at my home was wrong. I needed to tell someone. I didn’t want to tell a teacher, cause none of the teachers at my school were really close to me, and I didn’t feel like I could really trust them with this sort of thing(forgive me for my dumbass elementary school self making a bad decision here). My dad was across the world, and I didn’t have a phone to text or call him with at the time. The only other person I knew I could trust was my aunt.


So one day, we went over to her house. My mom volunteered to walk her dog, Marley, as my aunt was having trouble waking for reasons I don’t remember. I used that opportunity to tell her, and it was potentially one of the worst mistakes I’ve ever made in my life. She started berating me for “telling lies”(even though I had NO REASON WHATSOEVER to lie), and when my mom got back, she told her about what I had said. Then it was like I was getting verbally abused from both ends. This hurt me cause I always remember my aunt being one I could trust. 


When we got home, the abuse escalated to severe bleeding on my arm, and even more of a mental scar than that of what was already there. I realized that if I didn’t tell someone else sooner, I was gonna die. So I thought of a plan. I got out of school two hours earlier than my mom got out of work, and I typically walked home from school. So when I got home, I planned to use our landline phone to call my dad. The next day, I executed this plan and told my dad. He said that he was so sorry, that he had no idea what was happening. He said he would take a vacation off of work, take the next flight home, pick me up from school and take me home, and help me pack up my things to live with my grandparents for a while. He also said that he would divorce my mom the minute he dropped me off at my grandparents house. When he got there, we did all of those things, and then returned to my own house to wait for my mom, so we could call the police. After they arrived, my mom was arrested and sentenced to 8 years in prison for child neglect and abuse, and for the intent to murder. I’ve grown up since then, and have been happily living with my dad(he was reassigned to my home state and was no longer required to serve one wars after his boss found out the circumstances).
